finance_puzzle.question: A company has Revenue = ₹500 Cr, EBITDA margin = 15%, Debt = ₹500 Cr, Interest rate = 8%. What happens to profit (before tax) if revenue falls 15%?
finance_puzzle.answer:
Old EBITDA = ₹75 Cr → Profit before interest cost of ₹40 Cr = ₹35 Cr.
New revenue = ₹425 Cr → New EBITDA = ₹64 Cr → New profit before tax = ₹24 Cr.
That's a change of ₹-11 Cr — notice how a 15% revenue fall swings profit by a much bigger percentage. That's operating leverage.
